 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    one = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1)
    two = next((r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2)
    r, c = one
    tr, tc = two
    sr = 1 if tr > r else -1 if tr < r else 0
    sc = 1 if tc > c else -1 if tc < c else 0
    while abs(tr - r) > 1 and abs(tc - c) > 1:
        r += sr
        c += sc
        out[r][c] = 3
    while abs(tr - r) > 1 or abs(tc - c) > 1:
        if abs(tr - r) > 1:
            r += sr
        elif abs(tc - c) > 1:

    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
